browserRecycling.result: b0 recycled after 3 contexts served with 0 tabs; next open spawned b1

bugsFoundAndFixedDuringV12: Pool workers assigned before ready lost the run message (fork IPC drops messages with no listener): acquire() now requires ready, handler registered before ready is sent.

Pool worker read assignment.jobId but parent sends id: completion messages were dropped and jobs wedged running. Fixed to id || jobId, plus parent releases the worker on unknown-job terminal messages.
Concurrent tab opens each spawned a browser (pool registration happened after readiness): browsers now register before readiness resolves and createTab awaits readyPromise.
Control plane never decoded URL-encoded tab ids (b0%3A...): browserTabMatch now decodes; /api/browser/tabs forwards the agent filter (was referencing an undefined variable).
Daemon CONNECT relay dialed the target port instead of the proxy port: fixed to the proxy port; this was the root cause of all external page loads failing.
